title: H1: daily Coconala request re-scan (ids > last screened, 5316038 as of 10/09 am); send under PG-1 (widened lane, ≤5/day)
detail: Scan new public requests (https://coconala.com/requests?recruiting=true&sort=new) since the last screened id (5316038, or later if scan-1009pm ran) under the WIDENED lane (PROPOSAL_KIT §2/§2.5): any honestly-AI-deliverable digital task ¥3k–50k; prefer few applicants, ¥10k–15k, objective done-condition, free-sample risk reversal. Send under PG-1 when conditions 1-7 hold (log each). Cap ≤5/day combined with CrowdWorks. On done: create tomorrow's scan task (not_before next day 10:00 JST, id h1-coconala-scan-<MMDD>).
acceptance: screen appended; proposals logged with --grant PG-1; next scan task created
